canonical_definition:
What it is. Across papers, the prevailing description treats SUN397 as a scene dataset. One line of work describes it as a scene recognition dataset used for zero-shot transfer evaluation, while another describes it as a dataset for scene classification used to evaluate few-shot learning performance; one source also places it among publicly available image recognition datasets.

What it is claimed to measure. The reported measurement use is concentrated rather than spread across many targets. Papers link SUN397 to one behavioral indicator, Image classification, and to no constructs, using it to measure image classification in finetuning and broader benchmark evaluations.

Space of uses. Papers typically position SUN397 as one member of a larger evaluation suite rather than as a standalone protocol. It appears alongside Oxford Flowers, Food101, FGVC-Aircraft, and Sports100 in zero-shot reporting, and other papers include it among datasets used for finetuning and standard benchmark evaluation; no other measurement instrument is linked to it.
